# email-template-workflows

> A reusable GitHub composite Action (`LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows@v1`) that installs a Node.js consumer package, renders email templates to static HTML with npm, yarn, pnpm, bun or any CLI, uploads the HTML directory as a workflow artifact with a browsable `index.html`, and on pull requests posts or updates a single "Rendered emails" comment.

Use this Action when a repository builds HTML emails with an npm script or a CLI (MJML, Lit, Markdown-to-email, a template catalog) and you want CI to render them, publish them for review, and link them from the pull request. It is not an email sender, a linter, or a template library. It runs your build and publishes the result.

Pin to the floating major tag `@v1`. It tracks the latest `v1.x` release. Minimal call:

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v7
- uses: LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows@v1
  with:
    working-directory: .
    command: npx generate-template --all --out=generated
    artifact-directory: generated
```

## Pick a render mode

- Script mode: set `input` + `output`, or a multiline `templates` (`input:output` per line). The Action runs `<package-manager> run <build-script>` with the input and output paths (and `extra-args`) for each pair. Change how the paths are passed with `input-flag` / `output-flag` (`--src`, `--src=`, or empty for positional). `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_INPUT` and `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_OUTPUT` are always set.
- Build-command mode: set `build-command` plus `templates` (or `input` + `output`). The Action runs that shell command once per template, with the paths in `$EMAIL_TEMPLATE_INPUT` and `$EMAIL_TEMPLATE_OUTPUT`. Use it for MJML, Maizzle, pandoc or a script in any language.
- Command mode: set `command` and `artifact-directory`. The Action runs the shell command as-is (no flags appended) and indexes the `*.html` files (any depth) in `artifact-directory`. `command` overrides every other render input.

The package manager is detected (`package-manager: auto`) from the `packageManager` field, then the lockfile in `working-directory` or its parents, then npm. `fail-fast: false` renders the remaining templates after a failure and fails the job at the end. `comment-key` gives a call its own pull request comment. A job summary and a Gmail-clipping size warning (`size-limit-kb`) are on by default.

## Docs

- [Agent playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/docs/agent-playbook.md): start here when adding this Action to a repository. Inspect, choose a mode, write the workflow, verify; copy-paste recipes; a table from log messages to fixes; hard rules
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/README.md): overview, usage, full inputs table, outputs, behavior notes
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/AGENTS.md): decision rules, input precedence, gotchas, and a checklist for agents wiring this Action into a repository
- [action.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/action.yml): the source of truth for inputs, outputs, defaults, and implementation

## Examples

- [Real consumer: matrix of 15 templates (script mode)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/_playing_with_lit/refs/heads/main/.github/workflows/render-email-action.yml): used in `LLazyEmail/_playing_with_lit`
- [Real-world walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/docs/real-world-example.md): explains the consumer workflow above line by line
- [Single template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/script-mode-single.yml)
- [Several templates via `templates:`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/script-mode-templates.yml)
- [Catalog engine via `command:`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/command-mode.yml)
- [Any CLI via `build-command` (MJML)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/mjml-build-command.yml)
- [pnpm workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/pnpm-monorepo.yml)
- [`fail-fast: false` and two comments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/keep-going-two-comments.yml)
- [Scheduled run, no pull request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/scheduled-summary-only.yml)
- [Matrix, one job per template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LLazyEmail/email-template-workflows/main/examples/matrix-script-mode.yml)
